judged.play: Post-map desk review showing Map 1 stats and MVP votes for 100 Thieves after a 13-3 victory.
judged.line: Come on man, you can't have an ace like that...
judged.reason: Post-game breakdown with low gameplay action compared to the live hype rounds later in the stream.

judged.play: Agent pick screen for Map 2 (Sunset) showing Asuna on Phoenix and Timotino on Neon as streamer taunts NRG fans.
judged.line: If you're an NRG fan, go home!
judged.reason: Fun pre-match trash talk, but lacks live in-game plays.

judged.play: Caster commentary before the match starts while the streamer talks about feeling energy surging through his veins.
judged.line: I've got so much energy surging through my veins right now guys.
judged.reason: Routine pre-game hype talk with no game action happening on screen.

judged.play: Streamer mocks caster comments about NRG's experience before Map 2 starts.
judged.line: We're not on your level, Mata, okay?!
judged.reason: Amusing fan banter, but lacks the excitement of actual round wins.

judged.play: 100 Thieves win the pistol round on Sunset and streamer jumps up screaming.
judged.line: GET HIM OUT OF HERE!
judged.reason: Standard pistol round win reaction that repeats similar energy seen throughout the watch party.

judged.play: NRG wins an eco round against 100T on Sunset and streamer rationalizes the loss.
judged.line: We were winning a little bit too easy, so we needed to just...
judged.reason: Streamer copes with a round loss; low play quality for 100T.

judged.play: 100T eco round setup with classics in A Main.
judged.line: GET HIM OUT OF HERE!
judged.reason: Generic eco round setup with his default kill callout.

judged.play: Streamer jokes about player Ethan's nose strip while waiting between rounds.
judged.line: You see that stuff on Ethan's nose? It's the lack of oxygen man.
judged.reason: Minor commentary beat during round downtime.

judged.play: Vora secures a clean multi-kill round win for 100T.
judged.line: THAT'S MY IGL! ARE YOU NOT ENTERTAINED?!
judged.reason: Combines a great multi-kill round win by Vora with one of his most iconic, quotable reactions.

judged.play: Replay of a 100T team ace round win as streamer laughs at NRG celebrating single round wins.
judged.line: A round is not a match, all right? Calm down!
judged.reason: Decent team play replay, but lacks the raw hype of live multi-kills.

judged.play: NRG takes another timeout, prompting streamer to mock their desperation.
judged.line: This is our qualification match, ladies and gentlemen!
judged.reason: Good comedic story beat mocking timeouts, but no active gameplay.

judged.play: 100T executes a 5v5 retake win on B site with Asuna getting key frags.
judged.line: GET HIM OUT OF THERE ASUNA!
judged.reason: Solid retake win, but surrounded by higher quality multi-kill highlights in this stream.

judged.play: Bang lands a rapid multi-kill to secure the round for 100T.
judged.line: BANG! BANG! YEAH BANG! BANG! THE BIGGEST OF THEM ALL BANG!
judged.reason: An explosive play from Bang accompanied by an energetic name-pun reaction.

judged.play: 100T dismantles NRG in a fast, flawless round win.
judged.line: They're all dropping like flies! Left and right!
judged.reason: Peak stream moment featuring a flawless round and top-tier explosive excitement.

judged.play: 100T tries to hunt down saving NRG players at the end of a round.
judged.line: Why are you running, bro?
judged.reason: Routine post-round saving chase with moderate energy.

judged.play: NRG calls another tactical timeout as streamer mocks them again.
judged.line: They're begging Valorant, 'Can we have one more, please?!'
judged.reason: Repeats the timeout taunt trope from earlier in the watch party.

judged.play: Bang gets a predicted Sheriff headshot entry on A site.
judged.line: I said it! I called it! Oh my goodness!
judged.reason: Nice prediction and clean shot, but shorter and less impactful than full multi-kill rounds.

judged.play: Asuna pops Run It Back ultimate and gets aggressive multi-kills to shut down NRG on A site.
judged.line: ASUNA BABY! WHAT'S UP ETHAN?
judged.reason: High play quality with Asuna's Phoenix ult entry play paired with peak hype clapping and yelling.

judged.play: Replay showing Cryo's crisp Operator flicks in A Link.
judged.line: Snappy without adjustment! I love that bro!
judged.reason: Great Operator multi-kill replay, though it is a replay rather than live reaction.

judged.play: Cryo hits a key Operator shot on B site during live play to seal the round.
judged.line: GET HIM OUT OF THERE!
judged.reason: Good single Op pick and round finish, but less impactful than the multi-kill clips.

judged.play: Replay of 100T completely shutting down NRG's site push.
judged.line: Oh my goodness! You can't stop us, bro!
judged.reason: Strong defensive hold replay, but overshadowed by live reactions to full team stomps.

judged.play: NRG wins a round using Sova ultimate on B site.
judged.reason: A round loss for 100T with calm analysis from the streamer.
